title: fix(platform-objects): distinct labels for three duplicate field pairs in ru, ar and fr bundles
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X3uspdPcdPc3xnBZPMB1GpS)_

Fixes #33645

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：平台对象的三份翻译包各改一个字段标签：俄语导入任务的「创建数量」改为「Создано записей」，阿拉伯语 OAuth 资源的「资源标识 URI」改为「معرّف URI للمورد」，法语用户的「直属上级」改为「Responsable hiérarchique」。另在现有的翻译包测试里加了一条检查：任何语言下，同一平台对象的两个可见字段不能显示同一个标签。
- **为什么改**：这三处各让同一对象的两个字段在该语言下同名（俄语「创建数量」和「创建时间」都叫 Создано，阿语 ID 和资源标识都叫 المعرّف，法语「负责人」和「直属上级」都叫 Responsable），表头出两列一样的名字，用户分不清。
- **风险与回滚**：只改了三个已翻译的字符串值，英文标签和翻译包结构不变；回滚即 revert。新检查只读本包的翻译包和对象定义，以后有人给平台对象加字段时若在某语言撞名会变红。
- **先看**：`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/fr.objects.generated.ts`（`manager_id`），`ru.objects.generated.ts`（`created_count`），`bundle-ownership.test.ts`（新检查）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/apps/translations/bundle-ownership.test.ts`，预期 18 个用例全绿，其中 12 个是每种语言一条的撞名检查。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Each pair below is two non-hidden fields of one platform object that one locale served under one label. One leaf of each pair is re-translated from its English source label and description; the bundle structure is untouched and none of the edited leaves has a `source-hashes` row.

| Locale | Object | Field kept | Field re-translated | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| ru | `sys_import_job` | `created_at` "Создано" (Created At; the word every other ru `created_at` leaf uses but one en echo) | `created_count` (Created, a row count in the Progress group) | "Создано" | "Создано записей" |
| ar | `sys_oauth_resource` | `id` "المعرّف" (ID; the word most other ar `id` leaves use) | `identifier` (Identifier, the RFC 8707 resource indicator URI) | "المعرّف" | "معرّف URI للمورد" |
| fr | `sys_user` | `accountable_user_id` "Responsable" (Accountable Owner; matches the `register_service_account` `ownerId` param) | `manager_id` (Manager, the direct manager in the reporting chain) | "Responsable" | "Responsable hiérarchique" |

- **Pin** (`bundle-ownership.test.ts`, a new `describe` beside the file's existing per-locale pin): for every owned object (read from the package's own `identity`, `audit`, `metadata`, `system` barrels plus `SysMetadataCommitObject`, cross-checked equal to the file's `OWNED_OBJECTS` list) and for the authored labels plus all 11 `*.objects.generated.ts` bundles, no two fields without `hidden: true` resolve to one trimmed label (bundle leaf when present, else the authored label). This is the comparison `field-label-duplicate` (#33545) makes on app metadata, which does not judge platform objects.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/33645-platform-duplicate-field-labels.md`, `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch.

## Tests

- `bundle-ownership.test.ts`: 18/18 passed (2 ownership, 3 sys_metadata_commit, 1 definition-roster, 12 per-locale label checks).
- Ablation (on committed head `63dfd530`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): fr `manager_id` put back to "Responsable" ⇒ `fr` case red with `sys_user: accountable_user_id and manager_id both read "Responsable"` (1 failed, 17 passed); restored, blob back to the HEAD blob `7beab32c`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Package suite and typecheck: see Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- **Sweep, measured:** a throwaway script (not committed) walked the 53 objects of `packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` across the authored labels and all 11 locale bundles in this folder. Two readings: (1) declared fields, leaf else authored label; (2) fields as served, the spec's `injectedSystemColumnDefs` under the declared fields, labels resolved through `translateObject` for every bundle locale plus `BUILTIN_SYSTEM_FIELD_LABEL_LOCALES`. Both found exactly the three pairs the card names and nothing else; a case-insensitive rerun of (1) found the same three. After the fix both report 0.
- Observed, not changed: ru `sys_metadata_commit.created_at` still reads the English fill "Created At" (it has a `ru.source-hashes.generated.ts` row, so it is a tracked untranslated fill, not a duplicate). Outside this card.
- Not changed: the fr action params (`set_user_manager.managerId`, `register_service_account.ownerId`) both still read "Responsable". They are dialog params on two different actions, not two columns of one object, so they are outside this class.

## Verification

All on head `63dfd530`. Full log: 64 lines, every one `exit 0`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: exit 0, Test Files 122 passed (122), Tests 1971 passed (1971).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 62 families for this diff; all 62 ran, exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 62 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- `pnpm check:i18n` (bundle drift against a fresh extract): exit 0, after a full `pnpm build` (119/119 tasks), so the leaf-only edits leave no structural drift. `pnpm check:i18n-stale-fill`: exit 0.
- First runs at exit 3 that were missing prerequisites, each exit 0 on rerun: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (pinned commit fetched), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:lean-entry-closure` (dist missing before the full build).
- CI owns the rest (the lint farm, Test Core including `test:repo`, Build Core); nothing in this diff edits a `repo` project test.
